plugins.name: outerpale-startup
plugins.description: Session start work for every repository: fetches its project CLAUDE.md from claude-setup, and a skill to write one.

plugins.name: magister
plugins.description: Magister: a background second perspective at design, UI and decision moments; findings go to OneDrive.

plugins.name: magister-avatar
plugins.description: Desktop side pane: Magister's avatar while it runs, and its report cut to the finding's link.

plugins.name: outerpale-mem
plugins.description: Memory that survives cloud sessions: OneDrive Claude/memory/<repo>/, loaded at session start, consolidated nightly.

plugins.name: outerpale-mem-global
plugins.description: Global memory every session shares: OneDrive Claude/memory/_global/, loaded at session start, consolidated nightly.

plugins.name: send-to-todoist
plugins.description: Right-click selected text, or the action items in a reply, to send them to Todoist labelled Claude; plans drafted in a side pane before they go.

plugins.name: jit
plugins.description: Just-in-time catching tests before every PR, in every repository: generated tests run on the change and its parent, likely bugs reported, tests that pin the change landed.
